items.q: Can foreigners really buy property in Saudi Arabia now?
items.a: Yes. The Law of Real Estate Ownership by Non-Saudis came into force in January 2026, allowing ownership in designated zones, mainly in Riyadh and Jeddah, with special conditions for Makkah and Madinah. The Executive Regulation was published in the Umm Al-Qura gazette on 3 July 2026. Always confirm specifics with REGA.

items.q: Where does Miftah AI's data come from?
items.a: From official open data: Ministry of Justice transaction records published on the National Open Data Portal, REGA's Real Estate Indicators, and KAPSARC price indices. We never scrape private websites.

items.q: Is Miftah AI a broker or a lawyer?
items.a: No. We provide facts and official data so you can make your own decision. We don't list properties, recommend what to buy, or give legal or financial advice.
Official transaction data is updated periodically, usually quarterly. Every number shows a 'data until' date, and these are recorded deal prices, not live asking prices.
English, Arabic, Urdu, Hindi and Chinese. The AI replies in whatever language you write in.
We're launching in phases, starting with Riyadh and Jeddah. Join the waitlist to get early access and help shape the product.

trust.rulesTitle: How the advisor is allowed to answer
rules: Use only numbers returned by data tools. Never estimate or guess a price.

pipeline.body: Official MOJ transaction files from the National Open Data Portal.

pipeline.title: Refresh

about.title: Opening the door to Saudi property for the world
about.story: Miftah means 'key' in Arabic. When Saudi Arabia opened property ownership to non-Saudis in 2026, millions of people, residents and investors alike, suddenly had a new door in front of them. But the key was missing: clear answers in their language, from official data. We're building that key.
about.mission: Give every foreign buyer clear, honest, sourced answers about Saudi property, in their own language.
about.vision: Become the trusted data layer for international real estate in Saudi Arabia and the wider Gulf.
about.vision2030: Vision 2030 aims to diversify the economy and welcome global investment. Transparent information for foreign buyers supports a healthy, trusted real estate market, and that's exactly what we're here to provide.

privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.intro: Miftah AI respects your privacy and is designed to comply with the Saudi Personal Data Protection Law (PDPL). We collect the minimum data needed to run the service.

sections.p: Waitlist and contact details you give us (email, name, nationality, city of interest, role, preferred language), questions you ask the advisor, and basic anonymous usage analytics.
To provide and improve the service, answer your messages, send updates you've agreed to, and check the quality and accuracy of AI answers.
Only as long as needed for these purposes. Chat logs are reviewed for quality and deleted or anonymised on a regular schedule.
Only service providers that help us run Miftah AI (such as hosting, database, email and analytics), under contracts that protect your data. We never sell personal data.
You can ask to access, correct or delete your data, or withdraw consent, at any time through the contact page on this website.
Questions about privacy: through the contact page on this website.

terms.title: Terms of Use
terms.intro: By using Miftah AI you agree to these terms. Please read them together with our Disclaimer and Privacy Policy.

sections.p: Miftah AI provides information about Saudi property based on official open data and published regulations. It does not list properties for sale or act as a broker.
Nothing on Miftah AI is legal, financial, tax or brokerage advice. You are responsible for your own decisions and should consult licensed professionals.
We work hard to keep data accurate and sourced, but official data can be delayed or incomplete and rules can change. Always verify with official sources.
Do not misuse the service, attempt to scrape it, resell its data without a licence, or use it for unlawful purposes.
Paid reports and plans will be sold through a merchant-of-record provider, whose terms also apply.
We may update these terms. Continued use means you accept the updated terms.

disclaimer.title: Disclaimer
disclaimer.intro: Miftah AI is an information service. Please read this carefully.

sections.p: Miftah AI is not a lawyer, licensed real estate broker, tax adviser or financial adviser. We give facts so you can decide; we do not tell you what to buy.
Prices are based on registered transactions from official sources, usually updated quarterly. They are recorded deal prices, not live asking prices, and are shown at district level.
Zone status is based on official publications and is re-checked regularly. Where status is 'to be verified', you must confirm with REGA or a licensed broker before buying.
During the pre-launch period, some numbers on this website are illustrative samples and are clearly labelled as such. Do not use them for decisions.
Data from the Ministry of Justice, REGA, KAPSARC and OpenStreetMap belongs to its owners and is used under their open-data terms with attribution.
